description.summary: This spell creates an aura of magical energy that grants you a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on all saves.
description.value: This spell creates an aura of magical energy that grants you a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on all saves. As an immediate action , you can discharge Guard to gain a +10 deflection bonus to AC or a +10 resistance bonus on saves for 1 round, must be done before rolling.
